text:
Rina: Quick catch — post-launch telemetry shows a few small regressions. Let's pick 3 quick, low-risk slices for the next 2 sprints: bug fixes, grooming, clear rollback plans.

Jon: Agreed. My shortlist: 1) API transient 429 retries (edge), 2) streaming UI shows stale spinner when chunking stalls, 3) narrow embed postprocess revert for 4 affected orgs (canary).

Alex: +1. Keep infra changes minimal. For 3) we should do per-org model pinning and 10% canary traffic for 48h.

Marta: Estimates: 1) 6-8h, 2) 2-4h, 3) ~2 days (ML + ops gating). Also propose a grooming ticket to add a "rollback plan" checkbox to PRs.

Rina: Acceptance criteria examples: API retry -> "<1% 429s per org over 24h; p99 delta <20%". Streaming -> "shows last-chunk timestamp; retry CTA after 7s stall". Embed revert -> "per-org eval set improves precision@5 by >3pt or abort".

OpsBot: [canary] Canary job created for API retry patch. Window=2h, auto-rollback on p99+error threshold.

Jon: Ops guardrail: abort if p95 latency increases >25% during canary. Add a synthetic probe exercising retry path every 30s.

Alex: UX detail for streaming: replace indeterminate spinner with chunk indicator + small "try again" link after 7s. Tiny copy change, big perceived quality win.

Marta: I'll run the grooming Loom and add the rollback checkbox to backlog PR template.

Rina: Owners? Jon takes retry, Alex takes streaming UX, Marta owns grooming + rollback checklist. I'll coordinate the embed canary with ML infra.

Jon: I'll pair on QA harness and the synthetic tests.

Rina: Recap and targets: retry (1 day), streaming UX (0.5 day), embed canary (2 days). I'll create sprint slices and tag owners. Flag scope concerns within 6h. :thumbsup:
